product_metadata.title: TODAY'S HOME Home Classic Tailored Bed Skirt Dust Ruffle, Cotton Blend Design, 14" Drop Length, Queen, Grey TOH24914GREY03
features: Timeless Design: Our tailored design features split corners for easy placement around bed posts for a clean and classic look that will match any style of bedding and room decor
Specifications: The queen-size fits all queen beds and measures 60 x 80 inches with a 14 inch drop length

Fresh Look: Our bed skirts are made from a 60% Cotton/40% Polyester blend and are machine washable. This fabric blend is pre-shrunk, wrinkle resistant, fade resistant, and extremely durable for years of use
Hidden Storage: Our bed skirt hides box springs, bed frames, and legs that you’d rather not be visible. The sleek design allows you to tuck things under your bed and keep them out of sight
Always in Style: The classic design of this bed skirt adds the perfect finishing touch to your bedding set and will coordinate with any current and future trends
description: Let’s face it, a bed doesn’t look fully pulled together without a bed skirt. Today’s Home Classic Tailored Bed Skirts are not only a decorative finishing touch, but they are also made for use. Made from a sturdy cotton/poly blend, they are both wrinkle and fade resistant. The bed skirt gives your decor a finished look while hiding any bins or other things stored under your bed. The classic design is both modern and timeless, and will also hide bed frames and legs. That means our dust ruffles look just as good with your grandmother’s quilt as they do with a patterned duvet that goes over your down comforter; they’re an accent that grows with you and your changing décor. The right finishing touch is always down to the details. Let Today’s Home help complete your finished room. Quick Tip: To remove any wrinkles, place the bed skirt in the dryer for five minutes with a damp washcloth on high heat. Today's Home reduced the size of our packaging to leave less of a carbon footprint.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low heat. Remove promptly. Warm iron bed skirt drop as needed. Do not iron platform.
